accounts.description: List of accounting objects to manage. Each item is a map with name, bytes, and packets keys, corresponding to the 'add' command arguments for nfacct.

accounts.items.description: Individual accounting object definition. Note: bytes and packets are stored as numbers in the schema but rendered as strings in the config file to match nfacct input format.

accounts.items.name.description: The name of the Netfilter accounting object.

accounts.items.bytes.description: Initial byte counter value for the accounting object.

accounts.items.packets.description: Initial packet counter value for the accounting object.
